notes: Expert prior. Weights apply to robust z-scores ((value - center) / scale). Retrain from operator verdicts with `python -m intel.train`.

factors.name: lawn_growth
factors.label: Lawn overgrowth (week over week)
factors.description: Vegetation greener and rougher than last sortie

factors.name: greenness_level
factors.label: Absolute greenness
factors.description: Excess-green index of the turf this week

factors.name: texture_level
factors.label: Turf roughness
factors.description: Laplacian variance over vegetation — unmowed turf is rough

factors.name: greenness_vs_grid
factors.label: Greener than neighbours
factors.description: Robust z-score of greenness against every parcel in the same flight

factors.name: texture_vs_grid
factors.label: Rougher than neighbours
factors.description: Robust z-score of turf roughness against the flight

factors.name: vehicle_static
factors.label: Vehicle never moves
factors.description: Same vehicle in the same spot as last sortie

factors.name: stillness
factors.label: No structural activity
factors.description: 1 − change_score/12: little persistent change outside vegetation

factors.name: clutter
factors.label: Debris on pavement
factors.description: Small anomalous blobs per 100 m² of pavement (bins, tarps, mail)

factors.name: persistence_weeks
factors.label: Consecutive weeks suspicious
factors.description: Prior sorties in a row scoring ≥ 60

factors.name: lgi_trend
factors.label: Overgrowth trend
factors.description: Slope of the lawn index over the last sorties (per week)

factors.name: alignment_quality
factors.label: Registration quality
factors.description: ORB/RANSAC inlier ratio; below the threshold the score is capped
